title: Postal validation with originals
brief: Extract valid postal values while retaining rejected originals.
instructions: Accept only trimmed US five digits or five-plus-four digits with one hyphen. Return accepted trimmed input as postal_code. Retain invalid non-NULL input unchanged as rejected_value; missing input gives two NULLs.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes contact_id,postal_text from raw_contacts without solving postal validation with originals.

hints.text: Use full-string matching rather than substring extraction.
Evaluate a validity flag on trimmed text, then independently select accepted and rejected outputs.
123456 is not a five-digit postal code; surrounding spaces are allowed only after trimming.
